predictions.articleTitle: Cardiff MET vs Ammanford AFC Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Home Firepower Expose Away Leaks?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Cardiff MET is projected to secure a regulation-time Home Win at Cyncoed Campus in an open match exceeding 2.5 total goals with both teams on the scoresheet.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Cardiff MET Home Win backed by 1.81 league goals per match, 13.00 home shots per game, and Ammanford AFC's 2.63 away goals conceded per match (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 total goals supported by a 3.37 combined Poisson goal expectancy and both clubs' high-scoring season match averages (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Contingency Angle: First-half low-block resistance delaying the home breakthrough until the second half (Draw-Win), or an Ammanford AFC transition goal tightening the winning margin to 2:1 (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Cardiff MET's 13.00 home shots target Ammanford AFC's 2.63-conceded away defense.

spf.comment: Anchored on the 2:1 and 3:1 home projections, Cardiff MET's 1.81 goals per match and 14.13-shot volume heavily outmatch Ammanford AFC's 0.81 scoring and 2.69 conceding averages.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.37 combined Poisson lambda (65.4% Over 2.5 probability) and season match totals averaging 3.25 for Cardiff MET and 3.50 for Ammanford AFC.

btts.comment: While Ammanford AFC averages 0.63 away goals, Cardiff MET concedes 1.44 goals per league game (32.6% Poisson clean-sheet rate), giving the visitors a viable route to one goal alongside a 60.3% BTTS baseline.

score.comment: Both 2:1 (9.7% Poisson peak) and 3:1 (7.3%) capture Cardiff MET's superior attacking output against a leaky visiting defense while accounting for the hosts' 1.44 conceded-per-match rate.

goals.comment: Matches the leading Poisson total-goal densities (21.9% for 3 goals, 18.5% for 4 goals) centered around a 3.37 combined goal expectancy.

bqc.comment: Win-Win mirrors Cardiff MET's fast start in August's 5:0 win (2:0 at HT), while Draw-Win covers an early Ammanford AFC low block yielding after halftime fatigue.
